sources.name: superpowers
sources.description: Core software development workflow skills: planning, TDD, debugging, review, and branch finishing.
sources.notes: Official plugin installs are also available for Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex. Use this entry when you want this repo's curated install script to manage it. Explicit skill list (not *) so brainstorming and requesting-code-review stay excluded. The OpenCode brainstorming agent in harnesses/opencode.json still needs the brainstorming skill installed.

sources.name: obsidian-skills
sources.description: Obsidian vault, Markdown, Bases, Canvas, and web extraction skills.

sources.name: grill-with-docs
sources.description: Relentless interview that sharpens a plan or design and writes ADRs and a glossary as decisions land.

sources.name: show-me
sources.description: Explain the current topic visually with pseudocode, call trees, file trees, Mermaid, diffs, or one focused HTML file.
sources.notes: Its last step runs `open <file>.html`, which exists only on macOS. On Linux or in remote sessions, publish the HTML through the harness artifact tool instead.

sources.name: ponytail
sources.description: Lazy-senior-dev coding mode: YAGNI, stdlib and native platform features before dependencies, shortest working diff. Plus a review skill that hunts over-engineering only.
sources.notes: Only the core skill and the review skill. ponytail-audit, ponytail-debt, ponytail-gain, and ponytail-help are one-shot reports or display cards. The upstream plugin's always-on hooks are not installed by the skills CLI, so ponytail activates on trigger words, not on every prompt. Ponytail governs implementation size, not scope; every requested behavior still ships.

sources.name: humanizer
sources.description: Rewrite AI-sounding text so it reads like a person wrote it, using the 35 patterns from Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing.
sources.notes: Owns AI-pattern removal. natural-copy-editing owns translation, English correction, and plain copy-paste output. When both apply, natural-copy-editing's output format wins.
